newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Nov bad-cheque rate drops to 0.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Nov bad-cheque rate drops to 0.60 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio fell to 0.60 percent in November from 0.64 percent in October, the central bank said in a statement on Saturday.
Bad cheques made up 0.42 percent of the total value of all cheques written, up slightly from 0.40 percent in October, the statement said.

The total number of bad cheques rose 32.23 percent from October while the value of bad cheques rose 23.73 percent. The central bank did not give specific totals for the value and number of bad cheques.
The bank said the increases were due to many bad cheques issued on the last day of October not being processed until early November because October 31 was a national holiday.
November also had two more working days than October, the bank said.
